name: Ilford Ortho Plus
notes: ORTHOCHROMATIC film (blue and green sensitive, no red; can be handled under a deep red safelight): the spectral sensitivity curve (page 1) stops at about 565 nm and falls almost vertically there, so red and orange render very dark. Wedge spectrogram to tungsten light (2850K) drawn as a line curve on a 'Sensitivity' axis with ticks 0.5 and 1.0 only; traced as sensitivity/v with numbers as printed (relative, linear or log not stated; frame bottom about 0.05). The curve runs about 352-565 nm with a dip near 510 nm and a peak near 540 nm; the 350 nm grid point repeats the start value.
iso 80 is the daylight rating (ISO 80/20, cassettes DX coded 80, measured for ID-11 normal contrast); for tungsten the sheet gives ISO 40/17, hence balance 'daylight'.

Characteristic curves (page 3) are three plots with two curves each, drawn with numeric axis labels (x 0 to 4 relative log exposure, no lux-seconds, no Log H Ref; y density 0 to 3.5, frame bottom = 0), each curve labelled with its Gbar. Plot 'curves' = Pictorial Contrast in ID-11 stock at 20C: v = 8 min (Gbar 0.62) and v-id11-10 = 10 min (Gbar 0.70); the sheet calls Gbar 0.62-0.70 normal for in-camera use, so which of the two is 'standard' is a judgement (8 min chosen, it is the sheet's listed ID-11 stock time). Extra plot names (a second and third frame with their own axes; the README has one 'curves' plot per sheet): 'curves-intermediate' = ILFORD PQU 1+9, 4 min (Gbar 0.80, v-pqu-4) and 12 min (Gbar 1.00, v-pqu-12); 'curves-high' = ILFORD PHENISOL 1+4, 3 min (Gbar 1.20, v-phenisol-3) and 10 min (Gbar 1.80, v-phenisol-10); all at 20C, intermittent agitation.

In every frame the two curves coincide below relative log exposure about 1.5 (pictorial) or 1.8-2.0 (intermediate, high), so the pair gives one toe there. Traced base+fog: pictorial about 0.07, high about 0.04, intermediate about 0.0 (the curve lies on the frame bottom). The traces stop at relative log exposure 3.95-4.0 where the curves reach the right frame edge, so the curves may continue beyond what is plotted; top densities: pictorial 1.76 and 1.47, intermediate 2.19 and 1.55, high 3.31 and 2.61.

Gridlines are drawn as grey lines (0.5 steps); where a curve crosses one the trace may be off by about 0.01. The Gbar labels were masked; where a label touches a curve (0.70, 1.80) the trace could be off by about 0.01 over a few columns.
No document code (footer 'Page n of 5, Oct 2019'), no granularity figure.
